excerpt: We believe the scientific study of catastrophic risks from AI has fallen far short of where we need to be.
paraphrase: OpenAI states that scientific study of catastrophic AI risk is currently inadequate.

excerpt: To help address this gap, we are introducing our Preparedness Framework, a living document describing OpenAI’s processes to track, evaluate, forecast, and protect against catastrophic risks posed by increasingly powerful models.
paraphrase: OpenAI introduces the Preparedness Framework as a living document for tracking, evaluating, forecasting, and protecting against catastrophic risks from powerful models.

excerpt: Our practical experience with iterative deployment has enabled us to proactively improve our technical and procedural safety infrastructure.
paraphrase: Iterative deployment experience has allowed proactive improvements to safety infrastructure.

excerpt: As our systems get closer to AGI, we are becoming even more careful about the development of our models, especially in the context of catastrophic risk.
paraphrase: As systems approach AGI, OpenAI is becoming more cautious about model development regarding catastrophic risk.

excerpt: This Preparedness Framework is a living document that distills our latest learnings on how to best achieve safe development and deployment in practice.
paraphrase: The Framework distills current learnings on achieving safe development and deployment.

excerpt: The processes laid out in each version of the Preparedness Framework will help us rapidly improve our understanding of the science and empirical texture of catastrophic risk, and establish the processes needed to protect against unsafe development.
paraphrase: The Framework's processes are intended to rapidly advance understanding of catastrophic risk and establish protective processes.

excerpt: The central thesis behind our Preparedness Framework is that a robust approach to AI catastrophic risk safety requires proactive, science-based determinations of when and how it is safe to proceed with development and deployment.
paraphrase: The Framework's central thesis is that safety requires proactive, science-based determinations of when development and deployment are safe.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
excerpt: Tracking catastrophic risk level via evaluations. We will be building and continually improving suites of evaluations and other monitoring solutions along several Tracked Risk Categories, and indicating our current levels of pre-mitigation and post-mitigation risk in a Scorecard.
paraphrase: OpenAI will build and improve evaluation suites across Tracked Risk Categories and report risk levels in a Scorecard.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
context_stem: Tracking catastrophic risk level via evaluations.
excerpt: Importantly, we will also be forecasting the future development of risks, so that we can develop lead times on safety and security measures
paraphrase: OpenAI will also forecast future risk development to build lead time for safety and security measures.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
excerpt: Seeking out unknown-unknowns. We will continually run a process for identification and analysis (as well as tracking) of currently unknown categories of catastrophic risk as they emerge
paraphrase: OpenAI will run an ongoing process to identify, analyze, and track currently unknown categories of catastrophic risk.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
excerpt: Establishing safety baselines. Only models with a post-mitigation score of "medium" or below can be deployed, and only models with a post-mitigation score of "high" or below can be developed further (as defined in the Tracked Risk Categories below).
paraphrase: Deployment is limited to models scoring medium or below post-mitigation, and further development is limited to models scoring high or below.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
excerpt: In addition, we will ensure Security is appropriately tailored to any model that has a “high” or “critical” pre-mitigation level of risk (as defined in the Scorecard below) to prevent model exfiltration.
paraphrase: Security measures will be tailored for models with high or critical pre-mitigation risk to prevent exfiltration.

section_heading: Our Preparedness Framework contains five key elements
excerpt: We also establish procedural commitments (as defined in Governance below) that further specify how we operationalize all the activities that the Preparedness Framework outlines.
paraphrase: Procedural commitments in the Governance section specify how Framework activities are operationalized.

excerpt: Our focus in this document is on catastrophic risk. By catastrophic risk, we mean any risk which could result in hundreds of billions of dollars in economic damage or lead to the severe harm or death of many individuals—this includes, but is not limited to, existential risk.
paraphrase: Catastrophic risk is defined as risk causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage or severe harm/death, including existential risk.
stated_bar: hundreds of billions of dollars in economic damage

excerpt: Proactive in this case refers to an aim to develop this science ahead of the first time it becomes necessary. Deployment in this case refers to the spectrum of ways of releasing a technology for external impact. Development in this case refers to the spectrum of activities to enhance the technology.
paraphrase: Defines proactive, deployment, and development as used in the document.
